supersedes: audits/api-webhooks-shape-snapshot-2026-06-04.json (additive — old file retained; only the failure-classified lifecycle fields are new)
scope: OWNER-SCOPED (API-key authenticated; not a public/landing surface). PII-free; no owner_key/secret in the list response.
naming_law: Owner-visible lifecycle uses neutral ops terms (delivery_state, quarantined, disabled). Public event fields use price_at_call / call, never price_at_signal / signal. No outcome_* / pfe_* / mae_* ever (Data Integrity).

new_in_this_wave.delivery_state: ALWAYS present — the subscription lifecycle SoT ∈ [active, degraded, quarantined, disabled]. The legacy `active` boolean is now PROJECTED from it (active := delivery_state IN (active,degraded)) and remains in the response byte-unchanged.
new_in_this_wave.failure_class: present ONLY when set — granular last-failure cause ∈ [http_410, http_5xx, http_4xx, timeout, conn, egress_block, tls, other, legacy].
new_in_this_wave.next_probe_at: present ONLY when set (quarantined subs) — epoch seconds of the next health-probe.
new_in_this_wave.last_success_at: present ONLY when set — epoch seconds of the last 2xx (probe OR real delivery).
new_in_this_wave.disabled_reason: present ONLY when set (disabled subs) — ∈ [permanent_http_410, quarantine_expired].

allowed_keys: secret (POST create only, includeSecret=true — returned ONCE)

lifecycle_contract.states: active → (transient failures) → degraded → (>= WEBHOOK_QUARANTINE_AFTER_FAILURES) → quarantined → (health-probe 2xx) → active | (7d no-recovery) → disabled
lifecycle_contract.permanent: http_410 → disabled(permanent_http_410) immediately (the ONLY instant hard-disable).
lifecycle_contract.projection: active is derived from delivery_state in the SAME write (single-derivation); the enqueue `WHERE active` hot-path is byte-unchanged.
lifecycle_contract.flag: new behavior gated WEBHOOK_AUTO_RECOVERY_ENABLED (default-on when WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_ENABLED=true; flip 0 = legacy one-way disable, no delivery_state transitions, no sweep).

consumers: webhook-delivery-canary.py (reads delivery_state='disabled' → TERMINAL-DISABLE page; quarantined/degraded = silent)
the in-process health-probe sweep (getQuarantinedDue → probe → auto-resume/back-off/expire)
drift_check_command: curl -s https://api.algovault.com/api/webhooks -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' | jq '.subscriptions[0] | keys'  # expect delivery_state present; NO outcome_*/pfe_*/mae_* keys
